entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A non-binary vampire mage-student and athlete at Strixhaven who joins Lorehold College to study archaeology.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elven hunter of Lorwyn who kidnaps Kirol, later joins Strixhaven's cross-planar student program.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: The teaching assistant who led Kirol's class to Harrier's Wood.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker who lured Kirol and classmates through an Omenpath; Maralen's brother.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A student who travels with Kirol to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and leads Eirdu to the plain.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A student lured with Kirol to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A student lured to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor who later casts herself and Jadzi into the nexus of wild magic.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin who offers the stranded students hospitality and a former companion of Maralen.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Queen of the faeries and former companion of Brigid, poisoned with moonglow.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The elven High Perfect who plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker, associate of Professor Liliana Vess, who rescues Kirol and guides the students home.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Professor of the Magibotanical Environments class.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A moon-headed, winged, six-armed elemental whose waking turns Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Isilu's sun-headed counterpart, who restores balance by embracing Isilu.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic who performs a ritual to calm it.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who confronts the students at Titan's Grave, blaming Jace Beleren.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker blamed by Chandra for disrupting the Archaics.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: A creature emitting waves of reality-warping magic that kidnapped Oracle Jadzi.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Beings Lluwen calls upon to help encase the Archaic.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Kirol studies.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college Kirol joins to study archaeology.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane to which the students are lured through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Kirol's native plane.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: A kithkin village that Isilu's passage turns to Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's palace.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: The forest where Kirol is kidnapped by Lluwen.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The site where the Dawning Archaic appears.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A path between planes through which Oko lured the students.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose losses made Kirol feel preserving history was more important than ever.

events.summary: On a class trip to Harrier's Wood, Oko lures Kirol, Abigale, Sanar and Tamira through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
events.quote: the faerie planeswalker Oko appeared and lured Kirol, along with their classmates Abigale , Sanar , and Tamira , through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

events.summary: The students find carvings of two winged creatures and accidentally wake the moon-headed Isilu, whose darkness floods the world.
events.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

events.summary: Brigid Baeli meets the students and offers them hospitality after the night erases the Omenpath.
Isilu walks past Goldmeadow, turning it into Shadowmoor; Brigid tells the students to flee toward Maralen's palace.
events.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

events.summary: In the Gilt-Leaf Wood the elven hunter Lluwen kidnaps Kirol unnoticed by the others.
events.quote: Kirol was kidnapped by the elven hunter Lluwen

events.summary: Morcant plans to poison Isilu with dawnglow and forces Kirol to harvest it; Ajani rescues Kirol from rimekin and Lluwen follows them.
events.quote: Kirol and Ajani fled the forest, and Lluwen decided to follow.

events.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen steal Morcant's dawnglow to counteract the moonglow poisoning Maralen and Tamira, handing it to Oko.
events.quote: snuck behind the elven lines and took the dawnglow, handing it off to Maralen's brother Oko

events.summary: Isilu and Eirdu defeat the elven forces and embrace, restoring balance to the plane.
events.quote: The two gods embraced, and balance was restored to the plane.

events.summary: The students return to Arcavios with Ajani via Shandalar, and Lluwen joins Strixhaven's cross-planar student program.
events.quote: Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program to escape the ruthless elven hierarchy of Lorwyn.

events.summary: Kirol joins Lorehold College and later helps investigate the Dawning Archaic, which kidnapped Oracle Jadzi.
events.quote: Kirol joined Lorehold College, seeking a degree in archaeology.

events.summary: Chandra confronts the group, believing Jace is to blame; the Archaic returns and they fall into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave.
events.quote: the students and planeswalkers fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it

events.summary: Tam casts herself and Jadzi into the nexus of wild magic, disrupting the ritual, so Lluwen finishes it with his friends and the Lumarets, stopping the Archaic.
events.quote: Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself

relations.quote: After joining Lorehold College, they began a degree in archaeology.

relations.note: affectionately calls them Kiki and joins their friends
relations.quote: They are affectionally called Kiki by Lluwen.
handing it off to Maralen's brother Oko

relations.note: plans to kill it with dawnglow
relations.quote: She concocted a plan of using dawnglow as a poison to kill the great elemental
Ajani joined them on an expedition to the Fields of Strife as their advisor.
queen of the faeries and a former companion of Brigid's
